label: Forked Tower
tooltip: Helpers for South Horn Forked Tower. North Horn support comes later.

draw_potential_trap_positions.label: Show possible trap spots
draw_potential_trap_positions.tooltip: Draw circles on known trap spawn points inside South Horn Forked Tower.

show_registration_countdown.label: Show registration countdown
show_registration_countdown.tooltip: Show Forked Tower registration / warmup countdown in the Critical Encounters list (South Horn).

auto_register_in_illegal_mode.label: Go to the tower when registration opens
auto_register_in_illegal_mode.tooltip: While Illegal Mode is on and Forked Tower registration opens, drop the current trip, travel to the entry pad and wait on it until you are teleported in. Illegal Mode turns off once you are inside. Blood (South Horn): you still offer Sanguine Ciphers at a reliquary yourself — BOCCHI only reminds you.
